exact_cas_identification.notes: CAS.PRG plus observed part, indices, hardware, software, production date, supplier and variant metadata.

exact_dde_identification.notes: D_MOTOR.GRP resolved to D71N47C0.PRG with observed identification metadata.

exact_egs_identification.notes: GS19D.PRG with observed part, indices, hardware, software, production date, supplier and variant metadata.

kl15.notes: KLEMMENSTATUS 64 and 65 map to KL15 inactive; 69 maps to KL15 active. Never suitable alone for engine-running.

kl50.notes: CAS.PRG/status_fzg_zustand KLEMMENSTATUS bits 4-5 followed KL50 OFF -> ON -> OFF as raw bytes 69/0x45 -> 85/0x55 -> 69/0x45, now corroborated by a real IFH Level 1 trace. Read-only state evidence only.

kl50_oem_start_transition.notes: OFF -> ON -> OFF is present both on-screen in Tool32 and in the real IFH trace; repeated 85 readings precede the return to 69.

kl50_duration.notes: IFH Level 1 has no supplied per-sample timestamps. Duration must not be inferred; a Level 3 trace is required.

kl50_rpm_temporal_alignment.notes: KL50 and RPM are confirmed separately, but no common timestamp basis is available yet.

engine_speed.notes: 0 rpm stopped and idle near 780/786.5 rpm observed through Tool32 and TestO.

engine_running_state.notes: Stopped, cranking and stabilized-running phases are now present across two real OEM-start observations; the future algorithm remains unvalidated and KLEMMENSTATUS remains disqualified as standalone engine-running evidence.

stopped_cranking_running_observations.notes: Physical STOPPED, CRANKING and RUNNING phases observed in two real starts; no final thresholds inferred.

transmission_pn.notes: Tool32 status_getriebeposition correctly followed physical P and N observations.

transmission_prnd_tool32.notes: P/R/N/D physical positions mapped to P/R/N/D through GS19D.PRG status_getriebeposition.

brake.notes: ISTA Brake actuated coherently followed released/pressed pedal; repetition still required.

engine_running_detection_algorithm.notes: Candidate hysteresis, consecutive-sample and timeout strategy only. No final thresholds and no control use.

terminal_50_start_request.notes: KL50 state is confirmed, but the request source or mechanism that causes it remains unknown.

cas_start_button_request.notes: No CAS START-button or start-request signal has been functionally identified.

oem_start_request_source.notes: The observed KL50 transition does not identify the OEM request source.

remote_start_actuation_mechanism.notes: No remote-start actuation or diagnostic command mechanism has been identified.

msa_start_correlated_bits.notes: MSAAV bit 5 and MSAAA/MSAEV bit 2 changed near one OEM start; correlation only.

msa_bit_functional_meaning.notes: No MSA bit is identified as KL50, starter request, authorization or CAS request.

oem_start_authorization.notes: The IFH trace confirms terminal state only and does not expose the OEM authorization mechanism.

start_inhibit_conditions.notes: Potential P/N and brake observations are not yet a validated start-inhibit policy.

can_identifiers.notes: No CAN identifier carrying KL50 or start-related information has been observed or added.
